I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well –Psalm 139:14.

We live in a world full of bacteria and viruses. It is estimated that there are 100 trillion bacteria in the average human body. This is a huge number and one that I can’t wrap my mind around. Normally, these bacteria aren’t toxic until they get out of balance or get to a place where they are not intended to be. God has made us in such a way that our bodies have immune capabilities that are amazing.

Antibody-making cells and T cells float around our blood streams like sentinels, waiting for foreign cells or toxins to appear. A simple activity, like brushing your teeth or getting a scratch on your arm, can release bacteria into your blood stream. If it wasn’t for our God-given immune systems, those bacteria could attach to different tissues and cause serious infections.

It is important that we understand some about our immune system and think about ways in which we can help it function better.

In the Beginning

After He finished, …God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good… –Genesis 1:31. This doesn’t just mean that it looked beautiful, although it did. It also means at that point in time all of Creation was working together. There were no pathogenic bacteria and no harmful viruses. Adam and Eve were created perfectly and did not require antibiotics or probiotics to fight off infections.

Before the Fall, there was no need for an immune system the way we need it today. Most likely, the immune system of that era probably served more like a disposal system, getting rid of cells that needed to be cleaned up.

After the Fall, everything was different. Bacteria and viruses began to be “pathogenic” or disease-causing.

Components of Our Immune Systems

When people think of the immune system, they mostly think of cells that make antibodies. These are a very important part of our bodies’ defenses, but there are also many others.

a. Skin…

Our first line of defense against many infections is our skin. Having our body covered with an intact coating of skin with healthy bacteria on its surface can prevent unhealthy organisms from getting into the tissue underneath the skin and even into the blood stream.

I have seen plenty of severe infections that followed incidents during which the skin was broken. Anything from stepping on a nail to a dog bite can lead to infection.

b. Lymphatic System…

When we think about our circulation, the first thing that comes to mind is the blood system with veins, arteries, and the heart. There is another system, called the lymphatic system, that is charged with carrying infection-fighting blood cells throughout the body and getting rid of toxic materials.

There are little filtration areas along this system called lymph nodes that swell up when dealing with infections. Often when someone has an upper respiratory infection, they will notice that the lymph glands in their neck swell up. This is a sign that the immune system is doing what it is supposed to.

c. Bone Marrow/Spleen…

The bone marrow makes infection-fighting cells. Many of these cells are stored in the spleen which acts as a huge filter for the blood. When the body detects any type of infection, these infection-fighting cells are released into the blood stream and into the lymphatic system to fight off the bacteria or virus which is causing that infection.

Thus, people who are missing their spleen have an increased risk for certain types of infection.

d. Immune Cells…

The “soldiers” of our immune system are: white blood cells, B cells (which make antibodies), and T cells. These are the cells that respond to any invasion of our body.

e. Complement System…

This is a system that many people do not know as much about. This system includes the liver, which makes small proteins that help immune cells perform better and causes antibodies to be more effective. These proteins are floating around in an inactive state until there is a sign of infection, then certain enzymes activate them to be ready to help with an infection-fighting response.

Things that Damage our Immune Systems

There are a number of things that weaken our immune systems and make them less able to respond to infections. In fact, all of these things contribute to stunting our bodies’ defenses.

  1. A poor diet
  2. Bad sleep patterns
  3. Certain medications (particularly steroids)
  4. Poorly controlled diabetes (or any other debilitating illness)

Additionally, high levels of anxiety release stress hormones into the body that can lead to poor immunity.

Attempting to eliminate these things is a start, but we should also make certain to replace them with a healthy lifestyle. Many of the things that make our immune systems stronger are obvious, but that doesn’t mean we are always good at doing these things. We may have developed unhealthy habits or perhaps we were never taught certain healthy lifestyle choices.

Eat the Right Foods

There is no one specific food or juice we can consume that will push us towards a healthy ideal. Rather we need to have a mixture of healthy foods which we eat and unhealthy ones which we limit.

The first thing I think about when it comes to “the right foods,” is antioxidants. Antioxidants are chemicals that bind up damaging molecules in our bodies called “free radicals.” Too many free radicals can lead to all sorts of diseases, including diabetes and cancer. Of course, other parts of our bodies, such as our immune system, don’t function as well in this situation either.

Foods that are high in added nitrates, like cured meats, tend to greatly increase these free radicals and should be avoided.

Eating lots of fruits and vegetables really helps to naturally increase our vitamin levels (particularly Vitamin C). Eating healthy fats (those high in omega-3 fatty acids) and avoiding unhealthy ones (those high in saturated fat) probably also positively impact our ability to fight infection.

Get Adequate (Good) Sleep

Studies have looked at the risk of catching the common cold and found that people who slept less were more likely to catch colds. The cutoff point seemed to be around six hours for adults (it is probably more for teens and children).1

This makes sense since our bodies heal the most when we are sleeping. If you are waking up feeling unrested, it is important to figure out why. Things like simply not sleeping long enough, poor sleep hygiene (such as going to sleep thinking about worries, or working right up until bedtime), and sleep apnea can all cause sleep that is not restorative to our bodies.

God made our bodies with a need to rest, and He made a day for that purpose. If nothing else, this is the message of the Sabbath Day (see Exodus 20:8-11).

Consider Probiotics

In the 1800s, men like Joseph Lister and Louis Pasteur pushed forward the germ theory of disease. They believed that bacteria (at that time they didn’t yet know about viruses) were the causes behind many diseases. This led to Joseph Lister pioneering the sterilization of surgical instruments.

In the years since, we have concluded that not all bacteria are “pathogenic” or disease-causing. Many of the bacteria on our skin and in our digestive tract are good bacteria. These good bacteria aid with digestion and protect us from the pathogenic (or bad) bacteria moving in to cause us problems.

Probiotics are found in yogurt and kefir, plus many other foods. Probiotics can also be taken as supplements via capsules or drops.

One study gave 326 children probiotics or a placebo during the cold season. The children who were receiving the probiotics had significantly fewer respiratory illnesses and fevers during those six months.2

People who include these foods in their diet and take some probiotic supplements tend to be healthier and have stronger immune systems.

Cut Down on Sugar Intake

We know that obesity and uncontrolled diabetes increase the risk of infections, both minor and severe. It seems that when there is too much sugar floating around in the blood stream, it gives bad bacteria the nutrients they need to grow quickly, and it causes immune systems to not function as well.

When white blood cells are surrounded by lots of sugar, they are less able to perform “phagocytosis” (the process of swallowing) and they are less able to prevent the invasion of bad bacteria or viruses.3

We may have difficulty cutting all sugar out of our diet, but limiting it seems to make a big difference with regard to how well our bodies can fight off infection.

Exercise Regularly

It probably goes without saying but waiting until you feel like you have a cold coming on and then rushing out to run three miles is probably not going to be helpful. In fact, it could make you feel a lot worse as you deal with a body that is unused to exercise, which is also dealing with an infection.

The key here is moderation. Extreme high levels of activity, like that of performance athletes preparing for a big race or event, seem to increase the risk of infections. However, moderate levels of exercising 30 minutes per day for five days a week is good advice to follow so we can condition our bodies so we will have healthy hearts as well as other healthy systems to protect us from those unseen outside invaders.

Cut Down on Stress

“Dear God…
Grant me the [grace] to accept the things I cannot change,
[the] courage to change the things [that] I can,
and [the] wisdom to know the difference.”

Chronic elevation of stress hormones is harmful for our bodies. Stress hormones increase blood pressure and pulse rate. They push up blood sugars and tend to increase inflammatory responses in our bodies.4

Basically, stress hormones do all of the necessary things within your body to prepare you if the situation should arise that you would need to run away from serious danger, such as a charging grizzly bear. However, this high of a level of stress hormones isn’t particularly helpful when it comes to dealing with a child’s health problem, or the family’s financial difficulty.

Every one of us has dealt with worry at one time or another. Yet, living in a chronic state of worry is not healthy, nor is it a place where God wants to see His people living. From a Christian standpoint, our goal must be to give these concerns to God. Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you –I Peter 5:7. We don’t need to live with anxiety and all of the negative changes it can inflict on our physical health.

Spend Time Outdoors

When people think of sunlight, they mainly seem to think about Vitamin D.

It is true that Vitamin D is produced when our skin is exposed to sunlight, but sun exposure actually does much more. For example, sunlight seems to get our immune cells functioning in top condition to fight infections. Basically, T cells move much faster and more effectively when they have exposure to sunlight.5 Also, sun exposure increases nitric oxide levels in our bodies. This helps dilate blood vessels, lower blood pressure, and is a heart healthy chemical.

As with all the things I have mentioned, moderation is the key. Overexposure in the hot sun can cause sun stroke, and too much ultraviolet light is damaging to our skin cells, which can lead to burns and even skin cancers.

Targeted Supplements

Supplements can be helpful to fill in the gaps in our diet or places where our bodies are simply not absorbing as much of something as they should.

Vitamin D is one that jumps to my mind as we know that low Vitamin D levels increase the risk of severe infections. Our bodies don’t really know where the Vitamin D comes from. While it is probably best to get this from a combination of food and sun exposure, including supplements of Vitamin D may be helpful for older people or for anyone who has trouble achieving this.6

Zinc has been shown (short term) to reduce duration of colds. I would caution here that it isn’t really meant to be taken every day, but more should be taken at the first symptom of an upper respiratory infection coming on. This isn’t a miracle supplement and in studies it only reduced cold symptom duration by about one day.7

Vitamin C is another thing that many take when they feel colds coming on. Studies seem to indicate that it is well tolerated and effective.8 It is probably best to get most of your Vitamin C from your diet and only to introduce extra Vitamin C when you feel infection symptoms coming on.

There are many other supplements that people take; these are just three of the more common ones.

God made our bodies with multiple different systems. These systems heal injuries, maintain our body, and protect it from a world damaged by the introduction of sin at the Fall of man, in the Garden of Eden. We are indeed fearfully and wonderfully made. These systems work without our even thinking about them.

It is important that we are conscious of ways in which we can help, and not impede, these wonderfully designed cells and structures that prevent damaging organisms from entering our bodies and causing infection. It isn’t that healthy living or being a child of God will prevent us from ever getting sick, but rather that making a conscious decision to follow the right path will improve our body’s function. I believe that if we are healthy, it will make it easier for us to fulfil our mission—to reach the world around us with the Gospel message.

Eu te louvarei, porque fui formado de modo assombroso e maravilhoso; maravilhosas são as tuas obras, e a minha alma o sabe muito bem –Salmo 139:14.

Vivemos num mundo cheio de bactérias e vírus. Estima-se que haja 100 trilhões de bactérias no corpo humano médio. É um número enorme, que não consigo sequer imaginar. Normalmente, essas bactérias não são tóxicas até que se desequilibrem ou cheguem a um lugar onde não deveriam estar. Deus nos fez de tal maneira que nossos corpos têm capacidades imunológicas extraordinárias.

Células produtoras de anticorpos e células T circulam pela corrente sanguínea como sentinelas, à espera do aparecimento de células estranhas ou toxinas. Uma atividade simples, como escovar os dentes ou fazer um arranhão no braço, pode liberar bactérias na corrente sanguínea. Se não fosse pelo nosso sistema imunológico, que nos foi dado por Deus, essas bactérias poderiam se fixar em diferentes tecidos e causar infecções graves.

É importante que entendamos um pouco sobre nosso sistema imunológico e pensemos em maneiras de ajudá-lo a funcionar melhor.

No princípio

Depois de terminar, …Deus viu tudo o que havia feito, e eis que era muito bom… –Gênesis 1:31. Isso não significa apenas que tudo era belo, embora fosse. Significa também que, naquele momento, toda a Criação funcionava em harmonia. Não havia bactérias patogênicas nem vírus nocivos. Adão e Eva foram criados perfeitos e não precisavam de antibióticos ou probióticos para combater infecções.

Antes da Queda, não havia necessidade de um sistema imunológico como o de que precisamos hoje. Muito provavelmente, o sistema imunológico daquela época servia mais como um sistema de descarte, eliminando células que precisavam ser removidas.

Depois da Queda, tudo mudou. As bactérias e os vírus passaram a ser “patogênicos”, ou causadores de doenças.

Componentes do nosso sistema imunológico

Quando as pessoas pensam no sistema imunológico, a maioria pensa nas células que produzem anticorpos. Elas são uma parte muito importante das defesas do nosso corpo, mas há muitas outras também.

a. Pele…

Nossa primeira linha de defesa contra muitas infecções é a pele. Ter o corpo coberto por uma camada íntegra de pele, com bactérias saudáveis em sua superfície, pode impedir que organismos nocivos penetrem no tecido sob a pele e até mesmo na corrente sanguínea.

Já vi muitas infecções graves que ocorreram após incidentes em que a pele foi rompida. Qualquer coisa, desde pisar num prego até ser mordido por um cão, pode levar a uma infecção.

b. Sistema linfático…

Quando pensamos na circulação, a primeira coisa que nos vem à mente é o sistema sanguíneo, com veias, artérias e o coração. Há outro sistema, chamado sistema linfático, cuja função é transportar pelo corpo células sanguíneas que combatem infecções e eliminar materiais tóxicos.

Ao longo desse sistema há pequenas áreas de filtragem, chamadas linfonodos, que incham quando estão lidando com infecções. Muitas vezes, quando alguém tem uma infecção das vias respiratórias superiores, percebe que os linfonodos do pescoço incham. Isso é um sinal de que o sistema imunológico está fazendo o que deve.

c. Medula óssea/baço…

A medula óssea produz células que combatem infecções. Muitas dessas células ficam armazenadas no baço, que funciona como um enorme filtro do sangue. Quando o corpo detecta qualquer tipo de infecção, essas células que combatem infecções são liberadas na corrente sanguínea e no sistema linfático para combater a bactéria ou o vírus que está causando a infecção.

Assim, as pessoas que não têm baço correm maior risco de certos tipos de infecção.

d. Células imunológicas…

Os “soldados” do nosso sistema imunológico são os glóbulos brancos, as células B (que produzem anticorpos) e as células T. São essas células que respondem a qualquer invasão do nosso corpo.

e. Sistema complemento…

Este é um sistema sobre o qual muitas pessoas não sabem muito. Ele inclui o fígado, que produz pequenas proteínas que ajudam as células imunológicas a funcionar melhor e tornam os anticorpos mais eficazes. Essas proteínas circulam em estado inativo até que haja um sinal de infecção; então, certas enzimas as ativam para que estejam prontas a ajudar na resposta de combate à infecção.

Coisas que prejudicam nosso sistema imunológico

Há várias coisas que enfraquecem nosso sistema imunológico e o tornam menos capaz de responder às infecções. Na verdade, todas elas contribuem para atrofiar as defesas do nosso corpo.

  1. Uma alimentação inadequada
  2. Hábitos de sono ruins
  3. Certos medicamentos (em particular, esteroides)
  4. Diabetes mal controlada (ou qualquer outra doença debilitante)

Além disso, níveis elevados de ansiedade liberam hormônios do estresse no corpo, o que pode levar a uma imunidade baixa.

Tentar eliminar essas coisas é um começo, mas também devemos nos certificar de substituí-las por um estilo de vida saudável. Muitas das coisas que fortalecem nosso sistema imunológico são óbvias, mas isso não significa que sempre sejamos bons em praticá-las. Podemos ter desenvolvido hábitos pouco saudáveis ou talvez nunca tenhamos aprendido certas escolhas de estilo de vida saudável.

Coma os alimentos certos

Não existe um alimento ou suco específico que possamos consumir para nos levar a um ideal de saúde. Em vez disso, precisamos combinar alimentos saudáveis, que devemos consumir, com alimentos não saudáveis, cujo consumo devemos limitar.

A primeira coisa em que penso quando se trata de “alimentos certos” são os antioxidantes. Antioxidantes são substâncias químicas que se ligam a moléculas nocivas do nosso corpo, chamadas “radicais livres”. Um excesso de radicais livres pode levar a todo tipo de doença, incluindo diabetes e câncer. É claro que, nessa situação, outras partes do nosso corpo, como o sistema imunológico, também não funcionam tão bem.

Alimentos com alto teor de nitratos adicionados, como carnes curadas, tendem a aumentar bastante esses radicais livres e devem ser evitados.

Comer muitas frutas e verduras realmente ajuda a aumentar naturalmente nossos níveis de vitaminas (em particular, de vitamina C). O consumo de gorduras saudáveis (ricas em ácidos graxos ômega-3) e a redução do consumo de gorduras não saudáveis (ricas em gordura saturada) provavelmente também têm um impacto positivo na nossa capacidade de combater infecções.

Durma o suficiente (e bem)

Estudos analisaram o risco de contrair um resfriado comum e descobriram que as pessoas que dormiam menos tinham maior probabilidade de pegar resfriados. O limite parecia ser de cerca de seis horas para adultos (provavelmente é mais para adolescentes e crianças).1

Isso faz sentido, pois nosso corpo se recupera principalmente enquanto dormimos. Se você acorda sem se sentir descansado, é importante descobrir o motivo. Coisas como simplesmente não dormir o suficiente, ter uma higiene do sono inadequada (por exemplo, ir dormir pensando nas preocupações ou trabalhar até a hora de se deitar) e ter apneia do sono podem fazer com que o sono não seja restaurador para o nosso corpo.

Deus criou nosso corpo com a necessidade de descansar e criou um dia para esse propósito. Se nada mais, essa é a mensagem do Dia de Sábado (ver Êxodo 20:8-11).

Considere os probióticos

No século XIX, homens como Joseph Lister e Louis Pasteur promoveram a teoria microbiana das doenças. Eles acreditavam que as bactérias (naquela época, ainda não sabiam da existência dos vírus) eram a causa de muitas doenças. Isso levou Joseph Lister a ser pioneiro na esterilização de instrumentos cirúrgicos.

Desde então, concluímos que nem todas as bactérias são “patogênicas”, ou causadoras de doenças. Muitas das bactérias que vivem na nossa pele e no nosso trato digestivo são benéficas. Essas bactérias benéficas ajudam na digestão e nos protegem contra bactérias patogênicas (ou nocivas) que, ao se instalarem, podem nos causar problemas.

Os probióticos são encontrados no iogurte e no kefir, além de muitos outros alimentos. Também podem ser tomados como suplementos em cápsulas ou gotas.

Em um estudo, 326 crianças receberam probióticos ou um placebo durante a temporada de resfriados. As crianças que receberam probióticos tiveram significativamente menos doenças respiratórias e febres durante esses seis meses.2

As pessoas que incluem esses alimentos na dieta e tomam alguns suplementos probióticos tendem a ser mais saudáveis e a ter um sistema imunológico mais forte.

Reduza o consumo de açúcar

Sabemos que a obesidade e o diabetes não controlado aumentam o risco de infecções, tanto leves quanto graves. Parece que, quando há açúcar demais circulando na corrente sanguínea, ele fornece às bactérias nocivas os nutrientes de que precisam para crescer rapidamente e faz com que o sistema imunológico não funcione tão bem.

Quando os glóbulos brancos estão cercados por muito açúcar, têm menos capacidade de realizar a “fagocitose” (o processo de engolir) e de impedir a invasão de bactérias ou vírus nocivos.3

Talvez tenhamos dificuldade para eliminar todo o açúcar da nossa alimentação, mas limitá-lo parece fazer uma grande diferença na capacidade do nosso corpo de combater infecções.

Pratique exercícios regularmente

Provavelmente nem é preciso dizer, mas esperar até sentir que está começando a pegar um resfriado e então sair correndo para correr cinco quilômetros provavelmente não vai ajudar. Na verdade, isso pode fazer você se sentir muito pior, enquanto lida com um corpo que não está acostumado a se exercitar e que também está enfrentando uma infecção.

O segredo aqui é a moderação. Níveis extremamente altos de atividade, como os de atletas de alto rendimento que se preparam para uma grande corrida ou competição, parecem aumentar o risco de infecções. No entanto, é aconselhável praticar exercícios em nível moderado, por 30 minutos ao dia, cinco dias por semana, para condicionar o corpo e ter um coração saudável, assim como outros sistemas saudáveis que nos protejam desses invasores externos invisíveis.

Reduza o estresse

“Querido Deus…
Concede-me a [graça] de aceitar as coisas que não posso mudar,
[a] coragem para mudar as coisas [que] posso,
e [a] sabedoria para saber a diferença.”

A elevação crônica dos hormônios do estresse é prejudicial ao nosso corpo. Esses hormônios aumentam a pressão arterial e a frequência cardíaca. Elevam o nível de açúcar no sangue e tendem a aumentar as respostas inflamatórias no nosso corpo.4

Basicamente, os hormônios do estresse fazem tudo o que é necessário no seu corpo para prepará-lo caso surja uma situação em que você precise fugir de um perigo grave, como um urso-pardo atacando. No entanto, um nível tão elevado de hormônios do estresse não é particularmente útil para lidar com um problema de saúde de uma criança ou com uma dificuldade financeira da família.

Todos nós já nos preocupamos em algum momento. No entanto, viver em um estado crônico de preocupação não é saudável, nem é um estado em que Deus deseja ver seu povo vivendo. Do ponto de vista cristão, nosso objetivo deve ser entregar essas preocupações a Deus. Lançando sobre ele toda a vossa ansiedade, porque ele tem cuidado de vós –1 Pedro 5:7. Não precisamos viver com ansiedade e com todas as mudanças negativas que ela pode causar à nossa saúde física.

Passe tempo ao ar livre

Quando as pessoas pensam na luz do sol, geralmente pensam principalmente na vitamina D.

É verdade que a vitamina D é produzida quando nossa pele é exposta à luz do sol, mas a exposição ao sol faz muito mais. Por exemplo, parece que a luz do sol faz com que nossas células imunológicas funcionem em ótimas condições para combater infecções. Basicamente, as células T se movimentam muito mais rápido e com mais eficácia quando expostas à luz do sol.5 Além disso, a exposição ao sol aumenta os níveis de óxido nítrico no nosso corpo. Isso ajuda a dilatar os vasos sanguíneos, baixar a pressão arterial e é uma substância benéfica para o coração.

Como em todas as coisas que mencionei, o segredo é a moderação. A exposição excessiva ao sol forte pode causar insolação, e a luz ultravioleta em excesso danifica as células da pele, o que pode levar a queimaduras e até mesmo ao câncer de pele.

Suplementos específicos

Os suplementos podem ser úteis para preencher lacunas na nossa alimentação ou suprir necessidades que surgem quando nosso corpo simplesmente não absorve determinada substância em quantidade suficiente.

Vitamina D é uma que me vem à mente, pois sabemos que níveis baixos de vitamina D aumentam o risco de infecções graves. Nosso corpo não sabe realmente de onde vem a vitamina D. Embora provavelmente seja melhor obtê-la por meio de uma combinação de alimentos e exposição ao sol, incluir suplementos de vitamina D pode ser útil para pessoas mais velhas ou para qualquer pessoa que tenha dificuldade em obtê-la dessa forma.6

Zinco demonstrou reduzir (a curto prazo) a duração dos resfriados. Eu recomendaria cautela: não é realmente para ser tomado todos os dias; é melhor tomá-lo assim que surgirem os primeiros sintomas de uma infecção das vias respiratórias superiores. Não é um suplemento milagroso e, nos estudos, reduziu a duração dos sintomas do resfriado em apenas cerca de um dia.7

Vitamina C é outra coisa que muitas pessoas tomam quando sentem que estão começando a pegar um resfriado. Os estudos parecem indicar que ela é bem tolerada e eficaz.8 Provavelmente, o melhor é obter a maior parte da vitamina C por meio da alimentação e só acrescentar vitamina C quando você sentir que os sintomas de uma infecção estão começando.

As pessoas tomam muitos outros suplementos; estes são apenas três dos mais comuns.

Deus criou nosso corpo com vários sistemas diferentes. Esses sistemas curam lesões, mantêm nosso corpo e o protegem de um mundo danificado pela introdução do pecado na Queda do homem, no Jardim do Éden. Somos, de fato, formados de modo assombroso e maravilhoso. Esses sistemas funcionam sem que sequer pensemos neles.

É importante estarmos atentos às maneiras de ajudar, e não prejudicar, essas células e estruturas maravilhosamente projetadas, que impedem organismos nocivos de entrar em nosso corpo e causar infecções. Não é que levar uma vida saudável ou ser filho de Deus vá nos impedir de adoecer algum dia; antes, tomar a decisão consciente de seguir o caminho certo melhora o funcionamento do nosso corpo. Acredito que, se tivermos saúde, será mais fácil cumprirmos nossa missão — alcançar o mundo ao nosso redor com a mensagem do Evangelho.

I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well –Psalm 139:14.

We live in a world full of bacteria and viruses. It is estimated that there are 100 trillion bacteria in the average human body. This is a huge number and one that I can’t wrap my mind around. Normally, these bacteria aren’t toxic until they get out of balance or get to a place where they are not intended to be. God has made us in such a way that our bodies have immune capabilities that are amazing.

Antibody-making cells and T cells float around our blood streams like sentinels, waiting for foreign cells or toxins to appear. A simple activity, like brushing your teeth or getting a scratch on your arm, can release bacteria into your blood stream. If it wasn’t for our God-given immune systems, those bacteria could attach to different tissues and cause serious infections.

It is important that we understand some about our immune system and think about ways in which we can help it function better.

In the Beginning

After He finished, …God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good… –Genesis 1:31. This doesn’t just mean that it looked beautiful, although it did. It also means at that point in time all of Creation was working together. There were no pathogenic bacteria and no harmful viruses. Adam and Eve were created perfectly and did not require antibiotics or probiotics to fight off infections.

Before the Fall, there was no need for an immune system the way we need it today. Most likely, the immune system of that era probably served more like a disposal system, getting rid of cells that needed to be cleaned up.

After the Fall, everything was different. Bacteria and viruses began to be “pathogenic” or disease-causing.

Components of Our Immune Systems

When people think of the immune system, they mostly think of cells that make antibodies. These are a very important part of our bodies’ defenses, but there are also many others.

a. Skin…

Our first line of defense against many infections is our skin. Having our body covered with an intact coating of skin with healthy bacteria on its surface can prevent unhealthy organisms from getting into the tissue underneath the skin and even into the blood stream.

I have seen plenty of severe infections that followed incidents during which the skin was broken. Anything from stepping on a nail to a dog bite can lead to infection.

b. Lymphatic System…

When we think about our circulation, the first thing that comes to mind is the blood system with veins, arteries, and the heart. There is another system, called the lymphatic system, that is charged with carrying infection-fighting blood cells throughout the body and getting rid of toxic materials.

There are little filtration areas along this system called lymph nodes that swell up when dealing with infections. Often when someone has an upper respiratory infection, they will notice that the lymph glands in their neck swell up. This is a sign that the immune system is doing what it is supposed to.

c. Bone Marrow/Spleen…

The bone marrow makes infection-fighting cells. Many of these cells are stored in the spleen which acts as a huge filter for the blood. When the body detects any type of infection, these infection-fighting cells are released into the blood stream and into the lymphatic system to fight off the bacteria or virus which is causing that infection.

Thus, people who are missing their spleen have an increased risk for certain types of infection.

d. Immune Cells…

The “soldiers” of our immune system are: white blood cells, B cells (which make antibodies), and T cells. These are the cells that respond to any invasion of our body.

e. Complement System…

This is a system that many people do not know as much about. This system includes the liver, which makes small proteins that help immune cells perform better and causes antibodies to be more effective. These proteins are floating around in an inactive state until there is a sign of infection, then certain enzymes activate them to be ready to help with an infection-fighting response.

Things that Damage our Immune Systems

There are a number of things that weaken our immune systems and make them less able to respond to infections. In fact, all of these things contribute to stunting our bodies’ defenses.

  1. A poor diet
  2. Bad sleep patterns
  3. Certain medications (particularly steroids)
  4. Poorly controlled diabetes (or any other debilitating illness)

Additionally, high levels of anxiety release stress hormones into the body that can lead to poor immunity.

Attempting to eliminate these things is a start, but we should also make certain to replace them with a healthy lifestyle. Many of the things that make our immune systems stronger are obvious, but that doesn’t mean we are always good at doing these things. We may have developed unhealthy habits or perhaps we were never taught certain healthy lifestyle choices.

Eat the Right Foods

There is no one specific food or juice we can consume that will push us towards a healthy ideal. Rather we need to have a mixture of healthy foods which we eat and unhealthy ones which we limit.

The first thing I think about when it comes to “the right foods,” is antioxidants. Antioxidants are chemicals that bind up damaging molecules in our bodies called “free radicals.” Too many free radicals can lead to all sorts of diseases, including diabetes and cancer. Of course, other parts of our bodies, such as our immune system, don’t function as well in this situation either.

Foods that are high in added nitrates, like cured meats, tend to greatly increase these free radicals and should be avoided.

Eating lots of fruits and vegetables really helps to naturally increase our vitamin levels (particularly Vitamin C). Eating healthy fats (those high in omega-3 fatty acids) and avoiding unhealthy ones (those high in saturated fat) probably also positively impact our ability to fight infection.

Get Adequate (Good) Sleep

Studies have looked at the risk of catching the common cold and found that people who slept less were more likely to catch colds. The cutoff point seemed to be around six hours for adults (it is probably more for teens and children).1

This makes sense since our bodies heal the most when we are sleeping. If you are waking up feeling unrested, it is important to figure out why. Things like simply not sleeping long enough, poor sleep hygiene (such as going to sleep thinking about worries, or working right up until bedtime), and sleep apnea can all cause sleep that is not restorative to our bodies.

God made our bodies with a need to rest, and He made a day for that purpose. If nothing else, this is the message of the Sabbath Day (see Exodus 20:8-11).

Consider Probiotics

In the 1800s, men like Joseph Lister and Louis Pasteur pushed forward the germ theory of disease. They believed that bacteria (at that time they didn’t yet know about viruses) were the causes behind many diseases. This led to Joseph Lister pioneering the sterilization of surgical instruments.

In the years since, we have concluded that not all bacteria are “pathogenic” or disease-causing. Many of the bacteria on our skin and in our digestive tract are good bacteria. These good bacteria aid with digestion and protect us from the pathogenic (or bad) bacteria moving in to cause us problems.

Probiotics are found in yogurt and kefir, plus many other foods. Probiotics can also be taken as supplements via capsules or drops.

One study gave 326 children probiotics or a placebo during the cold season. The children who were receiving the probiotics had significantly fewer respiratory illnesses and fevers during those six months.2

People who include these foods in their diet and take some probiotic supplements tend to be healthier and have stronger immune systems.

Cut Down on Sugar Intake

We know that obesity and uncontrolled diabetes increase the risk of infections, both minor and severe. It seems that when there is too much sugar floating around in the blood stream, it gives bad bacteria the nutrients they need to grow quickly, and it causes immune systems to not function as well.

When white blood cells are surrounded by lots of sugar, they are less able to perform “phagocytosis” (the process of swallowing) and they are less able to prevent the invasion of bad bacteria or viruses.3

We may have difficulty cutting all sugar out of our diet, but limiting it seems to make a big difference with regard to how well our bodies can fight off infection.

Exercise Regularly

It probably goes without saying but waiting until you feel like you have a cold coming on and then rushing out to run three miles is probably not going to be helpful. In fact, it could make you feel a lot worse as you deal with a body that is unused to exercise, which is also dealing with an infection.

The key here is moderation. Extreme high levels of activity, like that of performance athletes preparing for a big race or event, seem to increase the risk of infections. However, moderate levels of exercising 30 minutes per day for five days a week is good advice to follow so we can condition our bodies so we will have healthy hearts as well as other healthy systems to protect us from those unseen outside invaders.

Cut Down on Stress

“Dear God…
Grant me the [grace] to accept the things I cannot change,
[the] courage to change the things [that] I can,
and [the] wisdom to know the difference.”

Chronic elevation of stress hormones is harmful for our bodies. Stress hormones increase blood pressure and pulse rate. They push up blood sugars and tend to increase inflammatory responses in our bodies.4

Basically, stress hormones do all of the necessary things within your body to prepare you if the situation should arise that you would need to run away from serious danger, such as a charging grizzly bear. However, this high of a level of stress hormones isn’t particularly helpful when it comes to dealing with a child’s health problem, or the family’s financial difficulty.

Every one of us has dealt with worry at one time or another. Yet, living in a chronic state of worry is not healthy, nor is it a place where God wants to see His people living. From a Christian standpoint, our goal must be to give these concerns to God. Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you –I Peter 5:7. We don’t need to live with anxiety and all of the negative changes it can inflict on our physical health.

Spend Time Outdoors

When people think of sunlight, they mainly seem to think about Vitamin D.

It is true that Vitamin D is produced when our skin is exposed to sunlight, but sun exposure actually does much more. For example, sunlight seems to get our immune cells functioning in top condition to fight infections. Basically, T cells move much faster and more effectively when they have exposure to sunlight.5 Also, sun exposure increases nitric oxide levels in our bodies. This helps dilate blood vessels, lower blood pressure, and is a heart healthy chemical.

As with all the things I have mentioned, moderation is the key. Overexposure in the hot sun can cause sun stroke, and too much ultraviolet light is damaging to our skin cells, which can lead to burns and even skin cancers.

Targeted Supplements

Supplements can be helpful to fill in the gaps in our diet or places where our bodies are simply not absorbing as much of something as they should.

Vitamin D is one that jumps to my mind as we know that low Vitamin D levels increase the risk of severe infections. Our bodies don’t really know where the Vitamin D comes from. While it is probably best to get this from a combination of food and sun exposure, including supplements of Vitamin D may be helpful for older people or for anyone who has trouble achieving this.6

Zinc has been shown (short term) to reduce duration of colds. I would caution here that it isn’t really meant to be taken every day, but more should be taken at the first symptom of an upper respiratory infection coming on. This isn’t a miracle supplement and in studies it only reduced cold symptom duration by about one day.7

Vitamin C is another thing that many take when they feel colds coming on. Studies seem to indicate that it is well tolerated and effective.8 It is probably best to get most of your Vitamin C from your diet and only to introduce extra Vitamin C when you feel infection symptoms coming on.

There are many other supplements that people take; these are just three of the more common ones.

God made our bodies with multiple different systems. These systems heal injuries, maintain our body, and protect it from a world damaged by the introduction of sin at the Fall of man, in the Garden of Eden. We are indeed fearfully and wonderfully made. These systems work without our even thinking about them.

It is important that we are conscious of ways in which we can help, and not impede, these wonderfully designed cells and structures that prevent damaging organisms from entering our bodies and causing infection. It isn’t that healthy living or being a child of God will prevent us from ever getting sick, but rather that making a conscious decision to follow the right path will improve our body’s function. I believe that if we are healthy, it will make it easier for us to fulfil our mission—to reach the world around us with the Gospel message.

Θα σε δοξολογώ, γιατί με έπλασες με θαυμαστό και εκπληκτικό τρόπο· θαυμαστά είναι τα έργα σου, και η ψυχή μου το γνωρίζει πολύ καλά –Ψαλμός 139:14.

Ζούμε σε έναν κόσμο γεμάτο βακτήρια και ιούς. Υπολογίζεται ότι στο μέσο ανθρώπινο σώμα υπάρχουν 100 τρισεκατομμύρια βακτήρια. Είναι ένας τεράστιος αριθμός, που δεν μπορώ καν να συλλάβω. Συνήθως, αυτά τα βακτήρια δεν είναι τοξικά, εκτός αν διαταραχθεί η ισορροπία τους ή βρεθούν σε σημείο όπου δεν προορίζονται να βρίσκονται. Ο Θεός μάς έπλασε έτσι ώστε το σώμα μας να διαθέτει εκπληκτικές ανοσολογικές δυνατότητες.

Κύτταρα που παράγουν αντισώματα και Τ κύτταρα κυκλοφορούν στο αίμα μας σαν φρουροί, περιμένοντας να εμφανιστούν ξένα κύτταρα ή τοξίνες. Μια απλή δραστηριότητα, όπως το βούρτσισμα των δοντιών ή μια γρατζουνιά στο χέρι, μπορεί να απελευθερώσει βακτήρια στην κυκλοφορία του αίματος. Αν δεν είχαμε το ανοσοποιητικό σύστημα που μας έδωσε ο Θεός, αυτά τα βακτήρια θα μπορούσαν να προσκολληθούν σε διάφορους ιστούς και να προκαλέσουν σοβαρές λοιμώξεις.

Είναι σημαντικό να κατανοούμε ορισμένα πράγματα για το ανοσοποιητικό μας σύστημα και να σκεφτόμαστε τρόπους με τους οποίους μπορούμε να το βοηθήσουμε να λειτουργεί καλύτερα.

Στην αρχή

Αφού τελείωσε, …ο Θεός είδε όλα όσα είχε δημιουργήσει, και να, ήταν πολύ καλά… –Γένεση 1:31. Αυτό δεν σημαίνει μόνο ότι ήταν όμορφα, αν και ήταν. Σημαίνει επίσης ότι εκείνη τη στιγμή όλη η δημιουργία λειτουργούσε αρμονικά. Δεν υπήρχαν παθογόνα βακτήρια ούτε επιβλαβείς ιοί. Ο Αδάμ και η Εύα δημιουργήθηκαν τέλειοι και δεν χρειάζονταν αντιβιοτικά ή προβιοτικά για να καταπολεμούν τις λοιμώξεις.

Πριν από την Πτώση, δεν υπήρχε ανάγκη για ανοσοποιητικό σύστημα όπως το χρειαζόμαστε σήμερα. Πιθανότατα, εκείνη την εποχή το ανοσοποιητικό σύστημα λειτουργούσε περισσότερο σαν σύστημα απομάκρυνσης, αποβάλλοντας κύτταρα που έπρεπε να καθαριστούν.

Μετά την Πτώση, όλα άλλαξαν. Τα βακτήρια και οι ιοί άρχισαν να είναι «παθογόνα», δηλαδή να προκαλούν ασθένειες.

Συστατικά του ανοσοποιητικού μας συστήματος

Όταν οι άνθρωποι σκέφτονται το ανοσοποιητικό σύστημα, συνήθως σκέφτονται τα κύτταρα που παράγουν αντισώματα. Αυτά αποτελούν ένα πολύ σημαντικό μέρος της άμυνας του σώματός μας, υπάρχουν όμως και πολλά άλλα.

α. Δέρμα…

Η πρώτη γραμμή άμυνάς μας απέναντι σε πολλές λοιμώξεις είναι το δέρμα μας. Το να καλύπτεται το σώμα μας από ένα άθικτο στρώμα δέρματος, με υγιή βακτήρια στην επιφάνειά του, μπορεί να εμποδίσει επιβλαβείς μικροοργανισμούς να εισχωρήσουν στον ιστό κάτω από το δέρμα, ακόμη και στην κυκλοφορία του αίματος.

Έχω δει πολλές σοβαρές λοιμώξεις που ακολούθησαν περιστατικά κατά τα οποία τραυματίστηκε το δέρμα. Τα πάντα, από το να πατήσει κανείς ένα καρφί μέχρι ένα δάγκωμα σκύλου, μπορούν να οδηγήσουν σε λοίμωξη.

β. Λεμφικό σύστημα…

Όταν σκεφτόμαστε την κυκλοφορία του αίματος, το πρώτο πράγμα που μας έρχεται στον νου είναι το κυκλοφορικό σύστημα με τις φλέβες, τις αρτηρίες και την καρδιά. Υπάρχει και ένα άλλο σύστημα, που ονομάζεται λεμφικό, το οποίο είναι επιφορτισμένο με τη μεταφορά των αιμοκυττάρων που καταπολεμούν τις λοιμώξεις σε όλο το σώμα και την απομάκρυνση τοξικών ουσιών.

Κατά μήκος αυτού του συστήματος υπάρχουν μικρές περιοχές φιλτραρίσματος, οι λεμφαδένες, που διογκώνονται όταν αντιμετωπίζουν λοιμώξεις. Συχνά, όταν κάποιος έχει λοίμωξη του ανώτερου αναπνευστικού, παρατηρεί ότι διογκώνονται οι λεμφαδένες στον λαιμό του. Αυτό είναι σημάδι ότι το ανοσοποιητικό σύστημα κάνει αυτό που πρέπει.

γ. Μυελός των οστών/σπλήνας…

Ο μυελός των οστών παράγει κύτταρα που καταπολεμούν τις λοιμώξεις. Πολλά από αυτά τα κύτταρα αποθηκεύονται στον σπλήνα, ο οποίος λειτουργεί ως ένα τεράστιο φίλτρο για το αίμα. Όταν το σώμα εντοπίσει οποιοδήποτε είδος λοίμωξης, αυτά τα κύτταρα απελευθερώνονται στην κυκλοφορία του αίματος και στο λεμφικό σύστημα, για να καταπολεμήσουν το βακτήριο ή τον ιό που προκαλεί τη λοίμωξη.

Έτσι, οι άνθρωποι που δεν έχουν σπλήνα διατρέχουν αυξημένο κίνδυνο για ορισμένα είδη λοιμώξεων.

δ. Ανοσοκύτταρα…

Οι «στρατιώτες» του ανοσοποιητικού μας συστήματος είναι τα λευκά αιμοσφαίρια, τα Β κύτταρα (που παράγουν αντισώματα) και τα Τ κύτταρα. Αυτά είναι τα κύτταρα που ανταποκρίνονται σε κάθε εισβολή στο σώμα μας.

ε. Σύστημα του συμπληρώματος…

Πρόκειται για ένα σύστημα που πολλοί άνθρωποι δεν γνωρίζουν καλά. Σε αυτό περιλαμβάνεται το ήπαρ, το οποίο παράγει μικρές πρωτεΐνες που βοηθούν τα ανοσοκύτταρα να λειτουργούν καλύτερα και κάνουν τα αντισώματα πιο αποτελεσματικά. Αυτές οι πρωτεΐνες κυκλοφορούν σε ανενεργή κατάσταση, μέχρι να εμφανιστεί ένδειξη λοίμωξης· τότε ορισμένα ένζυμα τις ενεργοποιούν, ώστε να είναι έτοιμες να συμβάλουν στην καταπολέμηση της λοίμωξης.

Πράγματα που βλάπτουν το ανοσοποιητικό μας σύστημα

Υπάρχουν διάφορα πράγματα που αποδυναμώνουν το ανοσοποιητικό μας σύστημα και μειώνουν την ικανότητά του να ανταποκρίνεται στις λοιμώξεις. Στην πραγματικότητα, όλα αυτά συμβάλλουν στην αναστολή της ανάπτυξης της άμυνας του σώματός μας.

  1. Κακή διατροφή
  2. Κακές συνήθειες ύπνου
  3. Ορισμένα φάρμακα (ιδίως τα στεροειδή)
  4. Κακώς ελεγχόμενος διαβήτης (ή οποιαδήποτε άλλη εξουθενωτική ασθένεια)

Επιπλέον, τα υψηλά επίπεδα άγχους απελευθερώνουν στο σώμα ορμόνες του στρες, οι οποίες μπορεί να οδηγήσουν σε μειωμένη ανοσία.

Η προσπάθεια να εξαλείψουμε αυτά τα πράγματα είναι μια αρχή, αλλά θα πρέπει επίσης να φροντίσουμε να τα αντικαταστήσουμε με έναν υγιεινό τρόπο ζωής. Πολλά από τα πράγματα που ενισχύουν το ανοσοποιητικό μας σύστημα είναι προφανή, αλλά αυτό δεν σημαίνει ότι τα κάνουμε πάντα καλά. Μπορεί να έχουμε αναπτύξει ανθυγιεινές συνήθειες ή ίσως να μη διδαχθήκαμε ποτέ ορισμένες υγιεινές επιλογές τρόπου ζωής.

Να τρώτε τις κατάλληλες τροφές

Δεν υπάρχει ένα συγκεκριμένο τρόφιμο ή ένας χυμός που μπορούμε να καταναλώσουμε και να μας οδηγήσει σε μια ιδανική κατάσταση υγείας. Αντίθετα, χρειάζεται να έχουμε έναν συνδυασμό υγιεινών τροφών που τρώμε και ανθυγιεινών που περιορίζουμε.

Το πρώτο πράγμα που σκέφτομαι όταν μιλάμε για «τις κατάλληλες τροφές» είναι τα αντιοξειδωτικά. Τα αντιοξειδωτικά είναι χημικές ουσίες που δεσμεύουν επιβλαβή μόρια στο σώμα μας, τα οποία ονομάζονται «ελεύθερες ρίζες». Οι υπερβολικά πολλές ελεύθερες ρίζες μπορούν να οδηγήσουν σε κάθε είδους ασθένειες, μεταξύ των οποίων ο διαβήτης και ο καρκίνος. Βέβαια, και άλλα μέρη του σώματός μας, όπως το ανοσοποιητικό σύστημα, δεν λειτουργούν εξίσου καλά σε αυτή την περίπτωση.

Τροφές με υψηλή περιεκτικότητα σε πρόσθετα νιτρικά, όπως τα αλλαντικά, τείνουν να αυξάνουν σημαντικά αυτές τις ελεύθερες ρίζες και θα πρέπει να αποφεύγονται.

Η κατανάλωση πολλών φρούτων και λαχανικών βοηθά πραγματικά στην αύξηση των επιπέδων βιταμινών με φυσικό τρόπο (ιδίως της βιταμίνης C). Η κατανάλωση υγιεινών λιπαρών (εκείνων που έχουν υψηλή περιεκτικότητα σε ωμέγα-3 λιπαρά οξέα) και η αποφυγή των ανθυγιεινών (εκείνων που έχουν υψηλή περιεκτικότητα σε κορεσμένα λιπαρά) πιθανότατα επηρεάζουν επίσης θετικά την ικανότητά μας να καταπολεμούμε τις λοιμώξεις.

Να κοιμάστε αρκετά και καλά

Μελέτες εξέτασαν τον κίνδυνο να κολλήσει κανείς κοινό κρυολόγημα και διαπίστωσαν ότι όσοι κοιμούνταν λιγότερο είχαν περισσότερες πιθανότητες να κρυολογήσουν. Το όριο φάνηκε να είναι περίπου έξι ώρες για τους ενήλικες (πιθανότατα περισσότερο για τους εφήβους και τα παιδιά).1

Αυτό είναι λογικό, καθώς το σώμα μας θεραπεύεται περισσότερο όταν κοιμόμαστε. Αν ξυπνάτε χωρίς να νιώθετε ξεκούραστοι, είναι σημαντικό να ανακαλύψετε τον λόγο. Πράγματα όπως το να μην κοιμάστε αρκετά, η κακή υγιεινή του ύπνου (όπως το να πηγαίνετε για ύπνο σκεπτόμενοι τις ανησυχίες σας ή να εργάζεστε μέχρι την ώρα του ύπνου) και η υπνική άπνοια μπορούν να έχουν ως αποτέλεσμα ο ύπνος να μην είναι αναζωογονητικός για το σώμα μας.

Ο Θεός έπλασε το σώμα μας με ανάγκη για ανάπαυση και όρισε μια ημέρα γι’ αυτόν τον σκοπό. Αν μη τι άλλο, αυτό είναι το μήνυμα της ημέρας του Σαββάτου (βλ. Έξοδος 20:8-11).

Εξετάστε το ενδεχόμενο λήψης προβιοτικών

Τον 19ο αιώνα, άνδρες όπως ο Τζόζεφ Λίστερ και ο Λουί Παστέρ προώθησαν τη μικροβιακή θεωρία των ασθενειών. Πίστευαν ότι τα βακτήρια (εκείνη την εποχή δεν γνώριζαν ακόμη την ύπαρξη των ιών) ήταν η αιτία πολλών ασθενειών. Αυτό οδήγησε τον Τζόζεφ Λίστερ να πρωτοπορήσει στην αποστείρωση των χειρουργικών εργαλείων.

Έκτοτε, καταλήξαμε στο συμπέρασμα ότι δεν είναι όλα τα βακτήρια «παθογόνα», δηλαδή δεν προκαλούν όλα ασθένειες. Πολλά από τα βακτήρια στο δέρμα μας και στον πεπτικό μας σωλήνα είναι ωφέλιμα. Αυτά τα καλά βακτήρια βοηθούν στην πέψη και μας προστατεύουν από τα παθογόνα (ή κακά) βακτήρια που εισέρχονται στο σώμα μας και προκαλούν προβλήματα.

Τα προβιοτικά βρίσκονται στο γιαούρτι και στο κεφίρ, καθώς και σε πολλές άλλες τροφές. Μπορείτε επίσης να λαμβάνετε προβιοτικά ως συμπληρώματα, σε κάψουλες ή σταγόνες.

Σε μία μελέτη, 326 παιδιά έλαβαν προβιοτικά ή εικονικό φάρμακο κατά την περίοδο των κρυολογημάτων. Τα παιδιά που λάμβαναν προβιοτικά είχαν σημαντικά λιγότερες αναπνευστικές ασθένειες και πυρετούς κατά τη διάρκεια αυτών των έξι μηνών.2

Οι άνθρωποι που συμπεριλαμβάνουν αυτές τις τροφές στη διατροφή τους και λαμβάνουν ορισμένα προβιοτικά συμπληρώματα τείνουν να είναι πιο υγιείς και να έχουν ισχυρότερο ανοσοποιητικό σύστημα.

Μειώστε την κατανάλωση ζάχαρης

Γνωρίζουμε ότι η παχυσαρκία και ο αρρύθμιστος διαβήτης αυξάνουν τον κίνδυνο λοιμώξεων, τόσο ήπιων όσο και σοβαρών. Φαίνεται ότι όταν κυκλοφορεί υπερβολική ποσότητα ζάχαρης στο αίμα, παρέχει στα επιβλαβή βακτήρια τα θρεπτικά συστατικά που χρειάζονται για να αναπτυχθούν γρήγορα και εμποδίζει το ανοσοποιητικό σύστημα να λειτουργεί εξίσου καλά.

Όταν τα λευκά αιμοσφαίρια περιβάλλονται από πολλή ζάχαρη, έχουν μικρότερη ικανότητα να εκτελούν «φαγοκυττάρωση» (τη διαδικασία κατάποσης) και να εμποδίζουν την εισβολή επιβλαβών βακτηρίων ή ιών.3

Μπορεί να δυσκολευόμαστε να αφαιρέσουμε εντελώς τη ζάχαρη από τη διατροφή μας, αλλά φαίνεται ότι ο περιορισμός της κάνει μεγάλη διαφορά στο πόσο καλά μπορεί το σώμα μας να καταπολεμά τις λοιμώξεις.

Να ασκείστε τακτικά

Μάλλον είναι αυτονόητο, αλλά το να περιμένετε μέχρι να νιώσετε ότι σας έρχεται κρυολόγημα και μετά να βγείτε βιαστικά για να τρέξετε πέντε χιλιόμετρα, πιθανότατα δεν θα βοηθήσει. Μάλιστα, μπορεί να σας κάνει να νιώσετε πολύ χειρότερα, καθώς το σώμα σας, που δεν είναι συνηθισμένο στην άσκηση, αντιμετωπίζει ταυτόχρονα και μια λοίμωξη.

Το κλειδί εδώ είναι το μέτρο. Τα εξαιρετικά υψηλά επίπεδα δραστηριότητας, όπως αυτά των αθλητών που προετοιμάζονται για έναν μεγάλο αγώνα ή μια διοργάνωση, φαίνεται να αυξάνουν τον κίνδυνο λοιμώξεων. Ωστόσο, είναι καλό να ακολουθούμε τη συμβουλή για μέτρια άσκηση 30 λεπτών την ημέρα, πέντε ημέρες την εβδομάδα, ώστε να γυμνάζουμε το σώμα μας και να έχουμε υγιή καρδιά, καθώς και άλλα υγιή συστήματα που θα μας προστατεύουν από αυτούς τους αόρατους εξωτερικούς εισβολείς.

Μειώστε το άγχος

«Αγαπητέ Θεέ…
Χάρισέ μου τη [χάρη] να αποδεχτώ όσα δεν μπορώ να αλλάξω,
[το] θάρρος να αλλάξω όσα [μπορώ],
και [τη] σοφία να γνωρίζω τη διαφορά.»

Η χρόνια αύξηση των ορμονών του στρες είναι επιβλαβής για το σώμα μας. Οι ορμόνες του στρες αυξάνουν την αρτηριακή πίεση και τους σφυγμούς. Ανεβάζουν το σάκχαρο στο αίμα και τείνουν να ενισχύουν τις φλεγμονώδεις αντιδράσεις στο σώμα μας.4

Βασικά, οι ορμόνες του στρες κάνουν όλα τα απαραίτητα πράγματα στο σώμα σας για να σας προετοιμάσουν σε περίπτωση που χρειαστεί να ξεφύγετε από έναν σοβαρό κίνδυνο, όπως μια αρκούδα γκρίζλι που ορμά καταπάνω σας. Ωστόσο, ένα τόσο υψηλό επίπεδο ορμονών του στρες δεν βοηθά ιδιαίτερα όταν πρόκειται για ένα πρόβλημα υγείας του παιδιού σας ή για τις οικονομικές δυσκολίες της οικογένειας.

Όλοι μας έχουμε αντιμετωπίσει κάποια στιγμή ανησυχίες. Ωστόσο, το να ζει κανείς σε μια διαρκή κατάσταση ανησυχίας δεν είναι υγιές, ούτε είναι μια κατάσταση στην οποία ο Θεός θέλει να βλέπει τον λαό Του να ζει. Από χριστιανική σκοπιά, στόχος μας πρέπει να είναι να παραδώσουμε αυτές τις έγνοιες στον Θεό. Ρίξτε επάνω του κάθε μέριμνά σας, επειδή αυτός φροντίζει για σας –Α΄ Πέτρου 5:7. Δεν χρειάζεται να ζούμε με άγχος και με όλες τις αρνητικές αλλαγές που μπορεί να επιφέρει στη σωματική μας υγεία.

Περνάτε χρόνο σε εξωτερικούς χώρους

Όταν οι άνθρωποι σκέφτονται το φως του ήλιου, φαίνεται ότι σκέφτονται κυρίως τη βιταμίνη D.

Είναι αλήθεια ότι η βιταμίνη D παράγεται όταν το δέρμα μας εκτίθεται στο ηλιακό φως, όμως η έκθεση στον ήλιο προσφέρει πολύ περισσότερα. Για παράδειγμα, φαίνεται ότι το ηλιακό φως βοηθά τα ανοσοκύτταρά μας να λειτουργούν στην καλύτερη δυνατή κατάσταση για να καταπολεμούν τις λοιμώξεις. Βασικά, τα Τ κύτταρα κινούνται πολύ πιο γρήγορα και αποτελεσματικά όταν εκτίθενται στο ηλιακό φως.5 Επίσης, η έκθεση στον ήλιο αυξάνει τα επίπεδα μονοξειδίου του αζώτου στο σώμα μας. Αυτό βοηθά στη διαστολή των αιμοφόρων αγγείων, στη μείωση της αρτηριακής πίεσης και είναι μια ουσία που ωφελεί την καρδιά.

Όπως και με όλα όσα ανέφερα, το κλειδί είναι το μέτρο. Η υπερβολική έκθεση στον καυτό ήλιο μπορεί να προκαλέσει θερμοπληξία, ενώ η υπερβολική υπεριώδης ακτινοβολία βλάπτει τα κύτταρα του δέρματός μας, γεγονός που μπορεί να οδηγήσει σε εγκαύματα, ακόμη και σε καρκίνους του δέρματος.

Στοχευμένα συμπληρώματα

Τα συμπληρώματα μπορεί να βοηθήσουν να καλυφθούν τα διατροφικά κενά ή οι περιπτώσεις στις οποίες το σώμα μας απλώς δεν απορροφά όσο χρειάζεται από κάποια ουσία.

Βιταμίνη D είναι ένα από τα πρώτα πράγματα που μου έρχονται στον νου, καθώς γνωρίζουμε ότι τα χαμηλά επίπεδα βιταμίνης D αυξάνουν τον κίνδυνο σοβαρών λοιμώξεων. Το σώμα μας δεν γνωρίζει πραγματικά από πού προέρχεται η βιταμίνη D. Παρότι πιθανότατα είναι καλύτερο να την προσλαμβάνουμε από έναν συνδυασμό τροφών και έκθεσης στον ήλιο, τα συμπληρώματα βιταμίνης D μπορεί να είναι χρήσιμα για τους μεγαλύτερους σε ηλικία ή για όποιον δυσκολεύεται να την εξασφαλίσει με αυτούς τους τρόπους.6

Ψευδάργυρος έχει αποδειχθεί ότι (βραχυπρόθεσμα) μειώνει τη διάρκεια του κρυολογήματος. Θα ήθελα να επισημάνω εδώ ότι δεν προορίζεται πραγματικά για καθημερινή λήψη· είναι προτιμότερο να λαμβάνεται περισσότερο με την εμφάνιση του πρώτου συμπτώματος λοίμωξης του ανώτερου αναπνευστικού. Δεν είναι ένα θαυματουργό συμπλήρωμα και, στις μελέτες, μείωσε τη διάρκεια των συμπτωμάτων του κρυολογήματος μόνο κατά περίπου μία ημέρα.7

Βιταμίνη C είναι ένα ακόμη πράγμα που πολλοί παίρνουν όταν νιώθουν ότι τους έρχεται κρυολόγημα. Οι μελέτες φαίνεται να δείχνουν ότι είναι καλά ανεκτή και αποτελεσματική.8 Πιθανότατα είναι καλύτερο να προσλαμβάνετε το μεγαλύτερο μέρος της βιταμίνης C από τη διατροφή σας και να προσθέτετε επιπλέον βιταμίνη C μόνο όταν νιώθετε να εμφανίζονται συμπτώματα λοίμωξης.

Υπάρχουν πολλά άλλα συμπληρώματα που λαμβάνουν οι άνθρωποι· αυτά είναι μόνο τρία από τα πιο συνηθισμένα.

Ο Θεός έπλασε το σώμα μας με πολλά διαφορετικά συστήματα. Αυτά τα συστήματα θεραπεύουν τραυματισμούς, διατηρούν το σώμα μας και το προστατεύουν από έναν κόσμο που έχει υποστεί βλάβη από την εισαγωγή της αμαρτίας κατά την Πτώση του ανθρώπου, στον κήπο της Εδέμ. Πράγματι, είμαστε πλασμένοι με θαυμαστό και εκπληκτικό τρόπο. Αυτά τα συστήματα λειτουργούν χωρίς καν να τα σκεφτόμαστε.

Είναι σημαντικό να έχουμε επίγνωση των τρόπων με τους οποίους μπορούμε να βοηθάμε και όχι να παρεμποδίζουμε αυτά τα υπέροχα σχεδιασμένα κύτταρα και τις δομές που εμποδίζουν τους επιβλαβείς οργανισμούς να εισέλθουν στο σώμα μας και να προκαλέσουν λοίμωξη. Δεν σημαίνει ότι η υγιεινή ζωή ή το ότι είμαστε παιδιά του Θεού θα μας εμποδίσουν να αρρωστήσουμε ποτέ· σημαίνει, αντίθετα, ότι αν αποφασίσουμε συνειδητά να ακολουθήσουμε τον σωστό δρόμο, θα βελτιωθεί η λειτουργία του σώματός μας. Πιστεύω ότι, αν είμαστε υγιείς, θα μας είναι ευκολότερο να εκπληρώσουμε την αποστολή μας—να μεταφέρουμε το μήνυμα του Ευαγγελίου στον κόσμο γύρω μας.

Greetings of Christian love to one and all. This past year and a half have been challenging in one way or another for most people. My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations; Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience. But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing –James 1:2-4.

We trust that no matter what each of you has faced your inner motivation echoes with the words of Apostle Paul, … for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content. I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need. I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me. –Philippians 4:11-13.

As we are already almost halfway through another year, I stop to consider how time keeps disappearing at an ever-increasing rate of speed. For many, the last 16 to 18 months have been quite challenging as the Covid-19 pandemic and its aftereffects continue to wreak havoc with all that used to be considered normal. For us, some of these aftereffects have hindered us from getting this issue of the magazine out in a timely manner. Our apologies. However, things are back on track to be able to get the next issue out within the next several months, thus allowing us to get back onto our normal schedule once more.

I see the pandemic and the resulting aftereffects as quite similar to one big traffic jam. First, many vehicles are all traveling along quite smoothly at the speed limit. Gradually more and more vehicles join the flow, until the highway becomes quite congested. However, things still continue to flow unhindered until suddenly one vehicle brakes sharply and swerves to avoid some debris on the roadway. Immediately, there is a ripple-effect or domino-effect, as each vehicle brakes to avoid hitting the one in front of them that just applied their brakes. I have seen this type of situation create stop-and-go traffic for a mile or more as traffic slows to a crawl, then once each vehicle finally gets past the offending object they can once more accelerate to their previous rate of speed.

With our world’s economies, both local and global, the same thing seemingly has happened, howbeit on a much, much larger scale. First came the shutdowns, both local and national, causing businesses to lose production and sales. Then as businesses reopened and their workers began to get sick, further production was lost. Suddenly, many manufacturers found themselves behind in their inventory reserve, which graduated into being behind in their ability to supply the demand. Since so much of our world’s businesses have developed trade at a global level, there are many products that are not available for sale as manufacturers wait for the “company overseas” to once more have enough supply to meet the global demand. Another problem that has developed more recently is that due to the major imbalance of supply versus demand on a global level, the cost of purchase for many products has skyrocketed awakening fears among some economists of a global crisis due to inflation.

Where does this leave the church? It seems that the “enemy of our souls” has used this global event to cause churches everywhere to struggle on many levels. I have on my bookshelf a book titled Conscience in Crisis, which is about church history. This book specifically examines the struggle of the “peace” churches in colonial America. One of the key points the book focuses on is that the global events of that time period shook the very foundations of their faith and practice. This caused the collective conscience of the churches to face an unprecedented crisis level, which many individuals never overcame. Some gave up the faith, some quit going to church, some walked away from their church and started going to more worldly churches. And the ones that remained, struggled substantially through many issues until they once more were considered stable.

Our Perspective Matters

When I think of the word perspective, the definition I am using is: a particular attitude toward, or way, of regarding something; a point of view. It is like the prescription of the glasses we have in front of our eyes causing us to see things in a distorted manner or with a clear 20/20 view. Or it is like using a filter in your computer or in your vehicle engine, which only lets through that which is pre-determined should be allowed.

So, our perspective is akin to using a filter or a pair of glasses. Our perspective is shaped by many things: the way we were trained as children, the role models we chose to follow during our formative years, the reading material we absorbed, the spiritual mentors we opened our hearts to, and the peers we embraced throughout our lifetime. Also, our perspective determines how we look at situations, how we interact with God, how we view sin and salvation, and how we respond to both friends and enemies.

In our world today, there are many perspectives, all vying for our allegiance. Many are the “special interest” groups clamoring for our support of their cause. There’s race discrimination on both sides of the matter. There are voices crying “foul” in their effort to gain support and an advantage against their opponents regarding voting rights, honesty of the election outcomes, and desired legislative changes to the judicial system and the Constitution. While there have always been multiple sides to an issue, there has usually been an effort to work together for the good of all. However, in the last number of years it seems that numerous issues have become quite divisive to the point of polarizing the people into two camps. The balance of power in government has been swinging back and forth from the one side to the other. This polarization has been causing bitterness and anger to build, in some instances erupting into violence and vandalism. In other instances, it has caused normally level-headed individuals to lose their cool and make “knee-jerk” reactionary decisions which are totally out of character for them.

In the midst of all this chaos and confusion, what is our perspective as the church? Are we remaining steadfast in allowing God and His Word to mold and shape our perspective to be aligned with His perspective? Or have we allowed the pressure of one peer group or another to start pushing us off-course in our walk as strangers and pilgrims?

I have heard reports of some churches in other parts of the world being pushed by their local government to not meet for fellowship and group worship. There are families whose conscience chooses to obey the government in long-term mask wearing and social distancing. Individuals have become discouraged. Families have become isolated. And churches have struggled through one issue after another in their efforts to maintain peace among the brethren.

As I have interacted with people who are not regular church goers, or those who attend a “dying” church, an “older” church, or a “small country” church, there are numerous things I have heard them testify regarding the churches of the conservative, Anabaptist persuasion. These people are awed by the way we help each other both on a regular basis and when tragedy strikes. They can’t comprehend the large size of our weddings and especially our funerals. They don’t understand how our children are mild-mannered and respectful of others.

Let’s take heed and use wisdom as we continue facing the challenges in the days to come. From my limited vantage point, I believe that long-term mask wearing and social distancing that is practiced at the expense of normal worship as we understand the Scriptures to teach, will eventually have a negative ripple effect on us as believers.

Many years ago, as I was involved in learning from the “counseling model”, it was spoken of as quite troubling and detrimental to interpersonal relationships IF someone had a “mask” on (figuratively). As I have evaluated and considered the long-term effect of a person having a “mask” on (literally), I believe it WILL cause as much and more detriment to interpersonal relationships. There is something about visiting with brothers and sisters of the faith when you can see their whole face. Without even realizing it, we read body language and facial expressions, which aids in understanding and conveying thoughts as we communicate with one another. Thus, it is my personal opinion that long-term mask wearing and social distancing by a local church body will eventually degrade the level of spiritual life and fervor to the point of someday that local body will no longer stand out from all the rest of the nominal Christians around them.

May God bless each one. May we not give up the spiritual fight. May we ever keep our eyes fixed on our Father, our Saviour, and our eternal home.

Curvin L Wenger

모든 분께 그리스도인의 사랑으로 문안드립니다. 지난 한 해 반 동안은 대부분의 사람에게 이러저러한 면에서 힘든 시간이었습니다. 내 형제들아, 너희가 여러 가지 시험을 당하거든 온전히 기쁘게 여기라. 이는 너희 믿음의 시련이 인내를 이루는 줄 너희가 앎이라. 인내를 온전히 이루라. 이는 너희로 온전하고 구비하여 조금도 부족함이 없게 하려 함이라 –야고보서 1:2-4.

여러분 각자가 어떤 일을 겪었든, 여러분의 내면의 동기가 사도 바울의 말에 담긴 마음과 같으리라 믿습니다. … 나는 어떤 형편에든지 자족하기를 배웠노니. 나는 비천에 처할 줄도 알고 풍부에 처할 줄도 알아, 모든 일과 모든 형편에서 배부르며 배고프며 풍부하며 궁핍하게 되는 비결을 배웠노라. 내게 능력 주시는 그리스도 안에서 나는 모든 것을 할 수 있느니라. –빌립보서 4:11-13.

또 한 해가 벌써 거의 절반이나 지나간 지금, 시간이 점점 더 빠른 속도로 사라져 가는 것을 생각해 봅니다. 많은 사람에게 지난 16~18개월은 꽤 힘든 시간이었습니다. 코로나19 팬데믹과 그 여파가 한때 정상이라고 여겨졌던 모든 것을 계속 뒤흔들고 있기 때문입니다. 우리에게는 이러한 여파 중 일부가 잡지 이번 호를 제때 발행하는 데 지장을 주었습니다. 사과드립니다. 그러나 이제 일이 정상 궤도로 돌아와 앞으로 몇 달 안에 다음 호를 발행할 수 있게 되었으며, 그로써 다시 평소 일정으로 돌아갈 수 있을 것입니다.

저는 팬데믹과 그로 인한 여파가 하나의 큰 교통 체증과 매우 비슷하다고 봅니다. 처음에는 여러 차량이 제한 속도로 순조롭게 달립니다. 점차 더 많은 차량이 흐름에 합류하면서 고속도로가 상당히 혼잡해집니다. 그래도 흐름은 계속 막힘없이 이어지다가, 갑자기 한 차량이 도로 위의 잔해를 피하려고 급히 브레이크를 밟고 방향을 틉니다. 곧바로 파급 효과, 또는 도미노 효과가 나타나 각 차량이 앞차와 충돌하지 않으려고 브레이크를 밟습니다. 이런 상황으로 인해 교통이 거의 기어가듯 느려지고, 1마일 또는 그 이상 구간에서 차가 섰다 가다를 반복하는 것을 본 적이 있습니다. 그러다가 각 차량이 마침내 문제의 물체를 지나고 나면 다시 이전 속도로 가속할 수 있습니다.

지역 경제든 세계 경제든, 우리 세계의 경제에서도 같은 일이 훨씬, 훨씬 더 큰 규모로 일어난 듯합니다. 먼저 지역과 국가 차원의 봉쇄가 있었고, 그로 인해 기업들은 생산과 판매에 차질을 빚었습니다. 그다음 기업들이 다시 문을 열고 노동자들이 병에 걸리기 시작하면서 생산은 더욱 감소했습니다. 갑자기 많은 제조업체가 보유 재고가 부족한 상황에 놓였고, 이는 수요를 공급할 능력마저 부족한 상황으로 이어졌습니다. 우리 세계의 많은 기업이 세계적인 차원에서 교역을 발전시켜 온 탓에, 제조업체들이 “해외에 있는 회사”가 세계 수요를 충족할 만큼 충분한 공급량을 다시 갖추기를 기다리는 동안 판매할 수 없는 제품이 많습니다. 최근에 생긴 또 다른 문제는 세계적 차원에서 공급과 수요의 불균형이 크게 벌어지면서 많은 제품의 구매 비용이 급등했고, 일부 경제학자들 사이에서 인플레이션으로 인한 세계적 위기에 대한 우려가 일어났다는 것입니다.

이런 상황에서 교회는 어디에 놓여 있습니까? “우리 영혼의 원수”가 이 세계적 사건을 이용하여 곳곳의 교회가 여러 면에서 어려움을 겪게 한 듯합니다. 제 책장에는 교회사를 다룬 『위기에 처한 양심』이라는 책이 있습니다. 이 책은 특히 식민지 시대 미국의 “평화교회”들이 겪은 어려움을 살펴봅니다. 이 책이 주목하는 핵심 내용 가운데 하나는 당시의 세계적 사건들이 그들의 신앙과 실천의 근간을 뒤흔들었다는 것입니다. 이로 인해 교회들의 공동 양심은 전례 없는 위기에 직면했고, 많은 개인은 그 위기를 극복하지 못했습니다. 어떤 이들은 신앙을 포기했고, 어떤 이들은 교회에 다니기를 그만두었으며, 어떤 이들은 자기 교회를 떠나 더욱 세속적인 교회에 다니기 시작했습니다. 남아 있던 사람들도 다시 안정된 것으로 여겨지기까지 여러 문제를 겪으며 상당한 어려움을 치렀습니다.

우리의 관점이 중요합니다

‘관점’이라는 단어를 생각할 때 제가 사용하는 정의는 무언가를 대하는 특정한 태도나 그것을 바라보는 방식, 즉 견해입니다. 그것은 우리가 눈앞에 쓴 안경의 도수와 같아서, 사물을 왜곡되게 보게 하거나 시력이 20/20인 것처럼 선명하게 보게 합니다. 또는 컴퓨터나 차량 엔진에서 필터를 사용하는 것과 같아서, 미리 정해 둔 기준에 따라 허용되어야 할 것만 통과시킵니다.

그러므로 우리의 관점은 필터나 안경을 사용하는 것과 비슷합니다. 우리의 관점은 여러 가지에 의해 형성됩니다. 어린 시절 받은 훈련, 성장기에 따르기로 선택한 본보기, 우리가 흡수한 읽을거리, 마음을 열고 받아들인 영적 멘토들, 그리고 평생 동안 가까이한 동료들이 그것입니다. 또한 우리의 관점은 상황을 바라보는 방식, 하나님과 교제하는 방식, 죄와 구원을 보는 방식, 친구와 원수 모두에게 반응하는 방식을 결정합니다.

오늘날 우리 세계에는 우리의 충성을 얻으려 다투는 여러 관점이 있습니다. 자신들의 대의를 지지해 달라고 목소리를 높이는 “특수 이익” 단체도 많습니다. 인종 차별은 양쪽 모두에서 나타납니다. 투표권, 선거 결과의 정직성, 사법 제도와 헌법에 바라는 입법적 변화와 관련하여 반대자들에 맞서 지지와 우위를 얻으려 “부당하다”고 외치는 목소리도 있습니다. 어떤 사안이든 늘 여러 입장이 있었지만, 대체로 모두의 유익을 위해 협력하려는 노력이 있었습니다. 그러나 지난 몇 년 동안 여러 사안이 사람들을 두 진영으로 양극화할 만큼 심하게 분열시키는 듯합니다. 정부의 권력 균형은 한쪽에서 다른 쪽으로 오락가락해 왔습니다. 이러한 양극화는 원망과 분노를 키우고 있으며, 어떤 경우에는 폭력과 기물 파손으로 분출되기도 합니다. 또 어떤 경우에는 평소 침착한 사람들마저 자제력을 잃고, 그 사람답지 않은 성급하고 반사적인 결정을 내리게 했습니다.

이 모든 혼란과 혼돈 속에서 교회로서 우리의 관점은 어떠합니까? 하나님과 그분의 말씀이 우리의 관점을 빚고 형성하여 그분의 관점과 일치하도록 계속 굳게 서 있습니까? 아니면 한 집단 또는 다른 집단의 압력에 굴복하여 나그네와 순례자로서 걷는 우리의 길에서 벗어나기 시작했습니까?

세계 다른 지역의 일부 교회가 함께 모여 교제하고 예배하지 말라는 지방 정부의 압력을 받고 있다는 소식을 들었습니다. 장기간 마스크를 쓰고 사회적 거리를 두라는 정부의 지침에 양심상 순종하기로 선택한 가정들도 있습니다. 낙심한 개인들이 생겼습니다. 고립된 가정들도 생겼습니다. 형제들 사이의 평화를 유지하려 애쓰면서 교회들은 이 문제 저 문제를 겪어 왔습니다.

정기적으로 교회에 다니지 않는 사람들, “쇠퇴하는” 교회나 “연로한” 교회, 또는 “작은 시골” 교회에 다니는 사람들과 이야기를 나누다 보면, 보수적인 아나뱁티스트 성향의 교회들에 대해 그들이 증언하는 이야기를 여러 가지 듣게 됩니다. 이들은 우리가 평소에도, 비극이 닥쳤을 때에도 서로 돕는 모습에 감탄합니다. 우리 결혼식의 규모, 특히 장례식의 규모를 이해하지 못합니다. 우리 아이들이 온순하고 다른 사람을 존중하는 모습을 이해하지 못합니다.

앞으로 다가올 날들에 계속해서 어려움을 맞이할 때 주의를 기울이고 지혜롭게 행동합시다. 제한된 제 시각에서 볼 때, 성경이 가르친다고 우리가 이해하는 정상적인 예배를 희생하면서까지 장기간 마스크 착용과 사회적 거리 두기를 실천하면 결국 믿는 우리에게 부정적인 파급 효과가 생길 것이라고 생각합니다.

여러 해 전, 제가 “상담 모델”을 배우는 데 참여했을 때, 누군가가 (비유적으로) “가면”을 쓰고 있다면 대인 관계에 상당히 문제가 되고 해롭다고 말했습니다. 한 사람이 (문자 그대로) “가면”을 쓴 채 지내는 것이 장기적으로 미칠 영향을 평가하고 생각해 본 결과, 저는 그것이 대인 관계에 그만큼, 아니 그보다 더 큰 해를 끼칠 것이라고 믿습니다. 믿음의 형제자매와 얼굴 전체를 볼 수 있는 상태로 대화할 때에는 뭔가 특별한 점이 있습니다. 우리는 자신도 모르는 사이에 몸짓과 얼굴 표정을 읽으며, 이는 서로 의사소통을 할 때 생각을 이해하고 전달하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 따라서 제 개인적인 견해로는, 지역 교회 공동체가 장기간 마스크를 쓰고 사회적 거리를 두면 결국 영적 생명과 열정의 수준이 저하되어, 언젠가는 그 지역 공동체가 주변의 다른 명목상의 그리스도인들과 더는 구별되지 않게 될 것입니다.

하나님께서 각 사람을 복 주시기를 바랍니다. 영적 싸움을 포기하지 맙시다. 우리의 아버지와 구주와 영원한 본향에 시선을 늘 고정합시다.

커빈 L. 웽거

God the Potter is molding me.
What kind of vessel will I be:
To carry, to store, or for a drink?
A lamp, or a plate, or a kitchen sink?

I’m a little bit shallow, I admit,
For I’m focusing on me quite a bit.
But here is a thought,
I’m not the only pot.

About my life
are many others,
A husband, a daughter,
and some brothers.

The Potter’s hand is on them, too,
Making each of us, something new.
Another pot gives me a bump,
And now I have a little lump.

Into another pot I smack,
It seems they now have a crack.
Back to the Potter’s wheel we go,
Until His likeness, again does show.

If what I do, and what I say,
Changes the course of other’s clay,
Then with great care, I must behave,
Lest other’s pots become concave.

Useful pots are God’s desire,
Ones that can withstand the fire.
It’s not just me, and it’s not just you;
God’s working with other vessels too.

by Elizabeth Rust

This poem was inspired by the Scripture passage in Jeremiah 18:1-6.

স্বীকার করি, আমার মনটা কিছুটা সংকীর্ণ,

জড়িয়ে আছে আরও অনেকে,
স্বামী, এক মেয়ে,
আর কয়েকজন ভাই।

কুমোরের হাত তাদের ওপরেও রয়েছে,
আমাদের প্রত্যেককে নতুন করে গড়ছে।
আরেকটি পাত্র আমাকে ধাক্কা দেয়,

মনে হয়, তাতে এবার চিড় ধরেছে।
আবার কুমোরের চাকায় ফিরে যাই,
যতক্ষণ না আবার তাঁর প্রতিমূর্তি ফুটে ওঠে।

আমি যা করি, আর যা বলি,

তবে আমাকে খুব সাবধানে চলতে হবে,
পাছে অন্যের পাত্র ভেতরের দিকে বেঁকে যায়।

ঈশ্বর চান পাত্রগুলো কাজে লাগুক,
আগুনের তাপ সহ্য করতে পারুক।
শুধু আমি নই, শুধু তুমিও নও;
ঈশ্বর অন্য পাত্রগুলোকেও গড়ছেন।
